Four Family Members Die of Electrocution in Maharashtra

In Satara, Maharashtra, four members of a family died after coming into contact with an electric current. The incident occurred when family members attempted to rescue one another after an initial electrocution. The exact circumstances leading to the initial electric shock are not detailed.
